searchText: Hi all, anyone in ETH Singapore? I'll be dropping tomorrow morning Giving a talk on Verkle Tries and Statelessness on 13th at Solidity Singapore. Please visit if possible. Awesome! I will be at ETH SG hackathon and look forward for your talk Niceee Going through the yellowpaper again, and I can see references as late as 2022 In fact this yellowpaper version is from august 2023, so it's a bit of a curiousity why the part about mining proof of work hasn't been updated to proof of stake ? Is this intentional ? > The Yellow Paper is out of date. It reflects the Ethereum specification up to the Berlin network upgrade, activated on the Ethereum mainnet at block 12_244_000 (April 2021). > > It does not contain changes introduced in following network upgrades, including London, Paris, or any post-merge upgrade. https://github.com/ethereum/yellowpaper well that makes sense, this date here sure threw me off:

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content:
> The Yellow Paper is out of date. It reflects the Ethereum specification up to the Berlin network upgrade, activated on the Ethereum mainnet at block 12_244_000 (April 2021).
> 
> It does not contain changes introduced in following network upgrades, including London, Paris, or any post-merge upgrade.

https://github.com/ethereum/yellowpaper
